body: From the DM-174 review (orchestrator): `endRun` (src/core/services/runs.ts, used by fail_run and cancel_run) cancels submitted attempts without recording handoff checks. `collaborationSignal` then treats each such closed, unchecked submission as unavailable, so C goes missing for the ticket and its whole sprint. Also, `stateAsOf` in src/core/services/spaceSignals.ts rewinds only accepted, rejected and failed attempts, so a submission canceled or expired after a cutoff still reads as closed at that cutoff. Decide how aggregation and the frozen snapshots treat both cases.
